newsitem.title: USA: Unifi completes Parkdale spun yarn venture.
newsitem.headline: Unifi completes Parkdale spun yarn venture.

text.p: Unifi Inc and private Parkdale Mills Inc said Tuesday they completed their spun yarn joint venture.
The companies said the venture, which was first announced June 17, combines Unifi's spun yarn assets with some of Parkdale's into a new company named Parkdale America LLC.
Majority owner Parkdale manages the venture's day-to-day operations and sells all yarns under the Parkdale brand, a statement said.

Unifi's stock hit a new intra-day high of 38-1/4 Tuesday. It traded at 37-15/16 in the early afternoon, up 9/16. When it announced the venture June 17, the company's stock jumped to 36-5/8 from a close of 33-1/2 the previous day.
